name: Say It Like a Creed
why_it_works: People don't just buy from brands; they join them. A short creed of 'We're the people who...' lines gives fans a shared identity they can repeat, quote and wear. Identity statements outlast offers because people defend who they are.

hook.pattern: Open on a single declarative identity line, spoken like a vow, with no product in sight.
examples: Not a slogan. A creed. Read along.

variables.name: brand
variables.description: Team, club, shop or brand name

variables.name: creed_line_one
variables.description: First identity line, an action starting with a lowercase verb, 5 words or fewer

variables.name: creed_line_two
variables.description: Second identity line, an action starting with a lowercase verb, 8 words or fewer
variables.example: wave at every lowrider, chrome or primer

variables.name: creed_line_three
variables.description: Third identity line, an action starting with a lowercase verb, 8 words or fewer
variables.example: bring the kids to every show

variables.name: refusal_line
variables.description: One thing the group never does, starting with 'never', 6 words or fewer

variables.name: gathering
variables.description: Where fans can show up or belong, a proper name starting with a capital letter, 7 words or fewer
variables.example: Sunday cruise night on Mission Avenue

visual.prompt: Vertical 9:16 dramatic low-angle portrait of a member of {{brand}} in their usual spot, dusk sky, warm rim light, proud calm expression
Vertical 9:16 photo of several members of {{brand}} together in their usual spot, laughing, golden hour light, candid, community feel
Vertical 9:16 slow tracking shot past families and members of {{brand}} at a gathering, kids in frame, warm evening light, joyful
Vertical 9:16 wide shot of the {{gathering}} for {{brand}}, people arriving, lights coming on, gentle camera rise, cinematic but natural

beats.voiceover: Sound like you? You're already one of us.

slides.headline: The {{brand}} creed
slides.body: Read it. If it fits, you're in.
slides.visual_prompt: Bold title card styled like a printed banner in {{brand}} colors, textured paper

slides.headline: We're the people who...
slides.visual_prompt: Member of {{brand}} standing proudly, dusk rim light, low angle

slides.headline: Who...
slides.visual_prompt: Group of {{brand}} members together, golden hour, candid

slides.headline: Who...
slides.visual_prompt: Families and kids at a {{brand}} gathering, warm evening light

slides.headline: And we never...
slides.visual_prompt: Simple bold type card, dark background, one line of text

slides.headline: Write your own line
slides.body: Start with a verb. Name an action, not an adjective. Keep it under six words.
slides.visual_prompt: Hand writing a short line on a blank index card with a marker, {{brand}} colors, top-down

slides.headline: How to join, in three steps
slides.body: 1. Come to {{gathering}}. 2. Say hi to one member. 3. Come back next time.
slides.visual_prompt: Simple numbered checklist card in {{brand}} colors, bold type, textured paper

slides.headline: Where to find us
slides.visual_prompt: Wide shot of the {{gathering}} with lights on, people arriving

craft.notes: Repeat the same opening ('Who...') so the lines feel like a chant and are easy to quote in comments. Every line must be an action, not an adjective: 'bring the kids' beats 'family-friendly'. The refusal line gives the creed teeth.

do_not: Write lines that exclude people for who they are rather than what they do
Show street racing, unsafe stunts or alcohol with driving
compliance: Fitness trainers: creed lines describe habits, never weight, body or health results
Car clubs and teams: never show street racing, unsafe stunts or alcohol near driving
Any real member shown must be a real photo with their consent, never a generated stand-in
